name: FFS_QTS_QUOTA_DAY_LOG
description: Stores a modification history for the corresponding parent table.

columns.name: QUOTA_LOG_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies log record of day level data changes.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Who Column: Time in GMT when action was performed.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Who Column: Identifies user the operation is performed by. Zero value means internal application task. Foreign Key. Points to USER_ID in FFS_USER.

columns.name: PAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to PAGE_ID in FFS_QTS_QUOTA_PAGE.

columns.name: OLD_QUOTA_PERCENT
columns.description: Old value of quota percent from max available.

columns.name: NEW_QUOTA_PERCENT
columns.description: New value of quota percent from max available.

columns.name: OLD_MIN_QUOTA
columns.description: Old value of minimum number of minutes to be allocated for booking of activities that belong to this day.

columns.name: NEW_MIN_QUOTA
columns.description: New value of minimum number of minutes to be allocated for booking of activities that belong to this day.

columns.name: OLD_QUOTA
columns.description: Old absolute value of quota in minutes.

columns.name: NEW_QUOTA
columns.description: New absolute value of quota in minutes.

columns.name: OLD_OPTIONS
columns.description: Old value of bitmask that defines status of quota record.

columns.name: NEW_OPTIONS
columns.description: New value of bitmask that defines status of quota record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
